violation_type.title: Parent Provided Meals/Snacks - Responsible for Snack if Parent Does Not Provide (26 TAC §746.3309(b))
violation_type.short_title: Parent Provided Meals/Snacks - Responsible for Snack if Parent Does Not Provide
violation_type.typical_finding: USDA requires snacks to include two meal components out of five (milk, grains, vegetables, fruits, and meat).  Center is providing one component for snack.
